notes:
Battistics Remote 1.1.0 is the iPhone companion to Battistics for Mac.

REVIEW WITHOUT A MAC
Choose Try a Sample Mac on the first screen. The built-in sample mode exposes the dashboard, battery details, accessories/apps, Keep Awake controls, widgets and Live Activity using synthetic readings. Sample commands never reach a real Mac. Show This iPhone’s Battery displays local device readings without a Mac.

REAL MAC SETUP
Download Battistics 1.6.0 or later from https://battistics.doguyilmaz.com. Sign in to iCloud with the same Apple Account on the Mac and iPhone. In the Mac app’s iPhone pane, enable Show this Mac in Battistics Remote. Allow Bluetooth and Local Network on both devices for nearby connections. Closed-lid control requires explicit enablement in that Mac pane; helper installation and permission changes take place on the Mac.

NEW IN THIS VERSION
Authenticated, encrypted local-network and Bluetooth connections alongside private CloudKit, automatic command handoff with duplicate protection, nearby permission status/recovery, and improved status reading and Live Activity lifecycle recovery. LAN discovery is foreground-only on iPhone; Bluetooth background delivery is controlled by iOS. Private iCloud remains available when nearby access is denied or devices are apart. The first trust setup requires working iCloud.

BACKGROUND AND PRIVACY
Bluetooth background mode carries status and user-issued controls for the nearby Mac. Background refresh and silent pushes reconcile Mac status and widgets/Live Activity. No audio, location or unrelated background work is used. The app does not request Location on iPhone. Last-update timestamps report the actual Mac sample; continuous background delivery is not promised. Data stays in the user’s private iCloud database or authenticated connections between their devices; no developer server or extra app account is used.

Screenshots use the app’s sample-mode UI, with separate original campaign illustrations. The app has no purchases or subscriptions. Setup/help: https://battistics.doguyilmaz.com/docs/iphone/
